Leading the session: Sandisk (SNDK, +11.90%); KLA Corporation (KLAC, +7.32%); Marvell Technology (MRVL, +7.05%). At the bottom: Lululemon Athletica (LULU, -17.38%); Fair Isaac (FICO, -16.68%); Autodesk (ADSK, -8.26%).

en: US markets were closed on Saturday, September 5, 2026, so there is no new session to report: the last one, September 4, 2026, was covered in the previous edition and its numbers are not repeated here. This edition reads instead the 109 stories published since then by 15 outlets we track, and brings forward the 24 that matter most.

Leading the weekend coverage: Financial Times reports: “Russian gold floods through Hong Kong in wake of western sanctions”; The Wall Street Journal reports: “How Billions in Iranian Money Passes Through U.S. Banks”; MarketWatch reports: “7% mortgage rates are already here, some buyers and mortgage experts say”.
By theme: Markets and macro (73), Crypto (10), Tech (12), Italy (8).

What did trade while the exchanges were shut, measured from Friday's US close: Solana +4.72%; Ethereum +2.00%; XRP +1.47%. These are the only market moves in this edition — they are quotes, not forecasts.
it: I mercati americani erano chiusi sabato 5 settembre 2026: non c'e' una seduta nuova da raccontare — l'ultima, 4 settembre 2026, e' gia' stata coperta dall'edizione precedente e i suoi numeri qui non vengono ripetuti. Questa edizione legge invece le 109 notizie uscite da allora su 15 testate seguite, e porta in primo piano le 24 piu' rilevanti.

In evidenza nel fine settimana: Financial Times riporta: «Russian gold floods through Hong Kong in wake of western sanctions»; The Wall Street Journal riporta: «How Billions in Iranian Money Passes Through U.S. Banks»; MarketWatch riporta: «7% mortgage rates are already here, some buyers and mortgage experts say».
Per tema: Mercati e macro (73), Crypto (10), Tech (12), Italia (8).

Cosa ha scambiato a borse chiuse, misurato dalla chiusura americana di venerdi': Solana +4,72%; Ethereum +2,00%; XRP +1,47%. Sono gli unici movimenti di mercato di questa edizione: quotazioni, non previsioni.
